fato_historico: 1988: The first Fairtrade label, Max Havelaar, is launched in the Netherlands.
energia_do_dia: The cosmic energy invites you to value fairness and integrity in all your interactions. Much like the birth of ethical trade, consider how your words and choices create a positive ripple effect. It is a good time to nurture balanced connections, perhaps finding deep satisfaction in being transparent, honest, and truly supportive to those within your vibrant social circle.
frase_do_dia: True balance is found when your actions reflect your highest and kindest intentions.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of harmony and grace in your daily life.
conselho: Seek mutual benefit in every conversation and keep your heart open to sincere connections.
